summary: Final approval of the review-flexibility PRD bytes. The PRD was revised once to fold in three accepted counter-review findings (config content leaves the input fingerprint; R4 scoped to approval gates with exception gates surviving; trigger rules fixed to per-project repo config) and passed a fresh independent review with no findings. You already approved the policy review and confirmed the config-residency decision implicitly stands unless changed. The PRD covers: free mid-project config editing with field-level change reporting instead of byte-pinning; wiring the per-dispatch route override through the semantic tools with skill outage guidance; targeted human approval via subject and content triggers with a default ruleset of PRD review, design review, and SQL file approval; ungated commits; a one-time amendment of this repo's constitution to narrow explicit-human-authority to triggered gates; and documentation updates. Approving here approves the exact final PRD bytes and hands off to architecture design.
